The '''Lota''' was one of the four [[akia]]s of [[Aramandi]] society. They were based on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Aram]], and the [[Lota system/Legends|Lota system]] has been earmarked for the akia's future colonization. Preparations were underway for the Lota to begin colonization during the early years of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="FBS" />

The Lota were the most conservative akia, taking long periods to make decisions as all options had to be considered and discussion at length. Other Aramandi viewed the Lota as slow moving [[Bureaucrat/Legends|bureaucrats]]. Members of the Lota generally dressed in embroidered [[Robe/Legends|robes]].<ref name="FBS" />
